securityBoundary.rule: Use only public design principles. Do not reproduce a real data center, continuity site, or underground facility's non-public layout, protection weaknesses, access sequence, utility topology, or emergency procedures.

securityBoundary.aviationStatus: The strip and helipad are scenic Minecraft representations. They are not represented as certified or operational aviation facilities.

atomicSequence: Freeze the snapshot and database hashes; census entities and active builders.
Export a canonical source ledger for every changed block, complete block state, block-entity NBT, inventory slot, item count, sign text and custom name.
Build the new shell as independently sealed monoliths; install joint waterstops, perimeter drain, sumps and temporary bulkheads before excavation between cells.
Build all stairs, routes, rooms and support systems with placeholder empty inventories.
Commission shell dryness, lighting, exits, bidirectional walking, room parity and media while the source remains untouched.
Migrate only a bounded NBT batch; hash source and target, then accept or roll back that batch before the next batch.
Run the complete 1896-block-entity and 5132-item-count reconciliation plus 36-object database crosswalk.
Switch wayfinding and access to the new shell while retaining the old source as rollback.
After a hold period and explicit acceptance, retire the old shell with exact rollback data; then complete the descending road, P01 surface and warehouse recovered pods.
Capture immutable post snapshot, import reviewed features, and run final route, concealment, inventory and media acceptance.

surfaceContract.rule: No operation may target y62, y63, y64 or any P01 bay, aisle, crosswalk, canopy, light or route. Each pod is lined and accepted dry before its connecting bulkhead opens.

parkingWarehouseExpansion.dependency: The recovered pods advance only after C01 migration acceptance and exact source retirement. C01 and warehouse transactions may not overlap.

releaseGates: No live command is authorized by this artifact.
Refresh to a new immutable same-moment snapshot and abort on snapshot or database hash drift.
Recompute every selected prism, road buffer, neighbor-fluid face, gravity cell, block entity, entity and protected-feature collision.
Keep the three natural cave/dungeon easements and wet-buffer habitat outside every operation.
Obtain an empty-world or offline simulation with exact forward and inverse operations before touching the world.
Require strict exact-state guards; no blanket SET or unmasked fill is permitted.
Clear players, bots, item entities, vehicles and active builders from each transaction cell.
Move beehives only with complete NBT, contained-bee and same-camera evidence; otherwise shift DM12.
Validate 40 rack rows in each hall, front/rear access, cross aisles, remote exits, NOC visibility and separated support traffic.
Test presentation and cinema independently at 200 seats, with separate public doors and two remote exit paths each.
Test the DM10-to-InfoBunker connector and remote egress in both directions without using the other route.
Do not claim the helipad or strip operational without FAA/design-aircraft review; preserve obstacle and safety buffers.
For C01, reconcile all 1896 block entities, 1622 inventories, 92 item stacks, 5132 item count and 36 database objects before source retirement.
Require C01 zero exposed concrete, minimum five-block cover at the compact shell, dry joints, working drains and two independent exits.
Build warehouse pods shell-first; accept each pod dry before opening one guarded bulkhead; preserve y62..64.
Run matched before/after captures, immutable post snapshot, database import, bidirectional walking and independent post-release acceptance.
